card.name: Kaladja
card.tagline: Slow gwoka rhythm of sorrow, hardship and love.
card.profile: Kaladja is one of the seven gwoka base rhythms, typically slow, expressing suffering, sadness, mourning, reflection and love; it is used at funeral wakes (veillees) and can be danced as a couple dance. Like the rest of the repertoire it is played on the ka drums (two boula plus make) with chacha and responsorial Creole song, danced within the lawonn at lewoz gatherings. Dancers perform slower, mournful gestures echoing the grief and hardship of enslaved communities (Wikipedia: Gwo ka; ZoukJam summarizing Repriz).
card.insight: Kaladja's slow, somber character makes it the gwoka rhythm most associated with laments and funeral wakes, contrasting with the festive toumblak and mennde.
